summary: iter_2 — Tested 4 new features: file uploads, OCR, TCMB FX refresh, AI Assistant. 17/18 pytest cases PASS (1 SKIP: OCR with dummy 1x1 PNG — endpoint accepts file but GPT-5.2 vision cannot parse 1x1 → returns error dict, which is expected). Frontend Playwright: /assistant page renders empty state with 6 suggestion buttons + Yeni Konuşma + session list, AI returns REAL numeric answer ('Vadesi geçmiş borç toplamı: $223,271'), session sidebar lists prior chats. /payables → New Payable slide-over shows OCR block ('Fatura görselinden otomatik doldur' + 'OCR ile Doldur' button, gradient/sparkles). Edit Payable slide-over shows 'Ekler (0)' section with 'Dosya Ekle' button. Smoke regression on auth + dashboard KPI: PASS. TCMB live fetch returned real rates (USD/EUR/GBP/JPY etc.) and updated currencies+fx_rates collections.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py reached ~1280 lines — strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth/, payables/, payments/, master/, reports/, uploads/, ocr/, ai/, fx/) for maintainability. Already flagged in iter_1.
ai_service.chat_with_assistant: when history is provided, it builds an LlmChat twice (lines 189 + 199) — the first allocation is thrown away. Minor inefficiency, no functional impact.
OCR endpoint stores temp file but does not check size limit (15MB cap only in /api/uploads, not in /api/ocr/invoice). Low risk but worth adding for defense-in-depth.
fx_service: bare 'except:' on line 34 should be 'except Exception:' (ruff style).

TCMB scheduler depends on container clock + timezone (UTC in container, TCMB 15:30 is Europe/Istanbul TZ) — currently runs at 15:30 UTC which is 18:30 Istanbul. Consider passing timezone='Europe/Istanbul' to cron job. Bültenler 15:30 İstanbul'da yayımlandığı için job şu anda 3 saat geç çekiyor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the new features verified visually

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. Test created 1 PNG upload and 1 AI session, both deleted in their own teardown tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features (file uploads, OCR endpoint, TCMB live FX, AI Assistant with context-injected RAG) are production-ready. AI Assistant returns real numeric data from MongoDB context (verified live: 'Vadesi geçmiş borç toplamı: $223,271', 'Bu ay vadesi: $17,285', 'MORNING gemisi $121,309 ile en yüksek'). TCMB returns ~22 currencies from live XML. Pytest regression at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py covers uploads CRUD, OCR mime-validation, /fx/refresh + /fx/latest + /fx/on-date, AI chat/sessions/messages/delete. New data-testids on frontend: nav-assistant, suggestion-* (8 found), payable OCR block visible in slide-over, Ekler section in edit slide-over. One observation: TCMB scheduler cron uses UTC (hour=15, minute=30) but bülten 15:30 İstanbul TZ — recommended to add tz='Europe/Istanbul' arg.
